#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

vector<long long> get_all_divisors(long long n) {
    set<long long> divisors_set;
    long long counter = 1;
    while (counter * counter <= n) {
        if (n % counter == 0) {
            divisors_set.insert(counter);
            divisors_set.insert(n / counter);
        }
        ++counter;
    }
    vector<long long> divisors_list(divisors_set.begin(), divisors_set.end());
    sort(divisors_list.begin(), divisors_list.end());
    return divisors_list;
}

int main() {
    const long long MODULUS = 1000000007;
    long long p_value, k_value;
    cin >> p_value >> k_value;

    auto mod_pow = [](long long base, long long exp, long long mod) -> long long {
        long long result = 1 % mod;
        long long b = base % mod;
        long long e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if (e & 1) {
                result = (result * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    };

    if (k_value == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p_value, p_value - 1, MODULUS) << "\n";
    } else if (k_value == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p_value, p_value, MODULUS) << "\n";
    } else {
        vector<long long> divisors = get_all_divisors(p_value - 1);
        for (auto candidate_divisor : divisors) {
            if ((p_value - 1) % candidate_divisor == 0 && mod_pow(k_value, candidate_divisor, p_value) == 1) {
                cout << mod_pow(p_value, (p_value - 1) / candidate_divisor, MODULUS) << "\n";
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
